todays_goal: Complete a protected 30-minute independent reading block.

lessons.subject: literature
lessons.previous_learning: The AR-weighted reading program was launched on Day 16 but the reading block was not completed.
lessons.course_context: Build daily reading stamina toward the 60-point semester goal.
learning_objectives: State one important change or idea from the reading.
lessons.why_it_matters: Daily sustained reading builds comprehension, vocabulary, stamina, and background knowledge.
lessons.written_instruction: Atticus: read your current AR book for 30 minutes. If you have not started one, begin The Westing Game. If an unfamiliar word blocks the meaning, ask for a quick plain-English definition and keep reading.

independent_practice.prompt: Read for 30 minutes and record the pages read.
In one sentence, say what changed, happened, or became clearer today.

exit_ticket.prompt: Give a 20-second oral recap of today's reading without looking at the book.
exit_ticket.answer: Student accurately states the main development from today's reading.

lessons.voice_prompt: Keep this block quiet. Do not interrupt reading. If Atticus asks about a word that blocks meaning, give a one-sentence plain-English definition with no spoiler. After reading, ask for a very short oral recap.
lessons.teacher_notes: Part of the 60-point semester reading goal.
